meta.source: Reserve Bank of India, Database on Indian Economy (via the Data Bank)
meta.revisionPolicy: Weekly reserves and daily rates are final on release. Investment flows, ECBs and LRS are revised in later Bulletins; external debt is provisional for a quarter, then partially revised.
meta.product: Foreign liabilities and assets of mutual funds and asset management companies (DBIE report 695)
meta.coverage: What Indian mutual funds and their managers owe abroad and own abroad, end-March
meta.note: RBI DBIE report 695, from the annual census of foreign liabilities and assets; as on 31 March. DBIE keys the lines by table number without naming the tables; the asset management companies' lines in table 1 equal the mutual funds' market-value liabilities plus other liabilities (6,113 = 6,107 + 6 US$ million in 2008-09), so table 1 looks like the combined total. Kept as published, with the table number in each label.
